data.one_liner: Pure‑Dart Google Sign‑In for Flutter, usable on mobile and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GoogleSignIn implementation that works on all Flutter platforms, including desktop, by handling OAuth flows in Dart. It can register a client ID and optional code‑exchange endpoint, and stores credentials via a custom Store.
use_when: Need Google Sign‑In on desktop or web‑like environments where native plugins are unavailable
Want a single package that works across all Flutter platforms without platform‑specific plugins
avoid_when: Using FirebaseAuth with the standard google_sign_in plugin
Running on older Flutter versions that lack desktop support
strengths: Pure Dart, no native platform code
Allows code‑exchange endpoint for long‑lived tokens
weaknesses: Requires manual registration of client ID
Limited to OAuth flows; no support for other auth providers
Not as battle‑tested as the official plugin
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, call GoogleSignInDart.register(clientId: …) before runApp, optionally provide exchangeEndpoint

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official plugin with native support and broader platform coverage
